candidates.change_summary: Remove the require(!locked_) assertion at the start of the modifier, disabling reentrancy protection.
Change _ assignment order so locked_ is set to false before executing the function body, breaking the reentrancy guard.
Replace `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value);` with `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, msg.value) + 1;`, altering the balance update.
Change the unlockTime assignment to always use block.timestamp, ignoring the parameter.
Remove the call to LogFile.AddMessage, which alters emitted log history (observable via Log contract).
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Put, allowing reentrant calls.
Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` with `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, 0);` so balance is reduced by zero on collection.
Delete the line that updates `acc.balance` so the user's balance is not reduced after a successful collect.
Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` with `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am - 1);` to deduct one less wei.
Replace `acc.balance = sub_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` with `acc.balance = add_uint256(acc.balance, _am);` so the balance increases instead of decreases on collect.
Remove `locked_ = true;` to break the reentrancy guard, allowing reentrant calls that could alter balances during a Collect.
Changed the Collect balance guard from >= _am to > _am, so a zero-value or exact-balance collect call diverges in whether it completes.
Changed the unlockTime check from block.timestamp > acc.unlockTime to block.timestamp >= acc.unlockTime, so collection at exactly unlockTime diverges.
Changed the external call to use transfer, making it revert on failure instead of silently continuing.
Made the external call revert on failure by requiring the call success flag to be true.
Changed the balance subtraction to set balance to zero after a successful collect, so subsequent state reads and collects diverge.
Deleted the call to LogFile.AddMessage in Collect, so logging behavior diverges after a successful collect.
Deleted the nonReentrant modifier body state update locked_ = true, so reentrancy is no longer blocked and Collect can be re-entered.
Remove the nonReentrant_ modifier from Collect, allowing reentrant external calls to alter Acc before the balance decrement completes.
Change the balance subtraction to subtract the raw argument _am without the sub_uint256 assertion, allowing underflowed balances if the condition is bypassed.
Move the balance update to before the external call, changing reentrancy-visible state timing while preserving post-return state.
Remove the locked_ = true statement from nonReentrant_, disabling the reentrancy guard for Collect and Put.
